decision_basis: Rolling-origin seasons 2023-2026. The previously published 2026 result is not relabelled untouched.

source.name: llimllib/nba_data derived from stats.nba.com
source.upstream_license: No license declared in the upstream GitHub repository as of build date
source.redistribution: Only derived pregame aggregates are published; raw parquet files are not vendored

methodology.rolling_origin: For each season, team/player configuration and Elo-combination weight use only earlier seasons.
methodology.fresh_check: The 71-game 2026-27 check is frozen from 2022-26 parameters but was not preregistered; treat it as small-sample corroboration, not a pristine untouched test.

models.v6_locked_blend: Previously fixed 80% Elo / 20% V5, slope .90, bias -.05
models.independent_team: No Elo score target; rolling pregame efficiencies and event rates
models.player_adjusted: Independent model plus prior-appearance expected-minutes impact proxy
models.v7_combined: Rolling past-season weight between Elo and player-adjusted model

methodology.availability: Historical official pregame injury status was unavailable. Every displayed player status is inferred and target-game minutes/participation are never used.

limitations: No reliable archive of timestamped official pregame injury reports was found; availability is inferred from prior appearances and is not an injury diagnosis.
Player impact is a transparent, heavily clipped on-court/box proxy—not EPM, RAPM or causal player value.
NBA player logs omit DNP rows, so missed games can mean injury, rest, coach decision or roster movement.
Shot-location and tracking fields were not added because the validated game-log source did not provide a complete five-season pregame-safe series.
The upstream nba_data repository declares no license; only derived factual aggregates are published, not raw parquet files.
Historical possession models use 300 seeded simulations per game for tractability; the live engine supports 100,000.
